title: Dark Energy in the DESI Era: A Brief Review of Evidence, Beyond-$Λ$CDM Interpretations, and Tensions
summary: Recent baryon acoustic oscillation measurements from DESI provide important new clues for reassessing whether the standard $Λ$CDM model offers a sufficient description of the late-time expansion history of the Universe. When combined with cosmic microwave background and type Ia supernova data, these measurements show an apparent departure from the $Λ$CDM model, commonly described as dynamical dark energy (DDE) with equation of state crossing the phantom divide (i.e., quintom behavior).
